LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 6.3.1 WORD CLASSES: ADVERBS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.3: Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should one use adverbs correctly?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify adverbs of frequency and degree correctly from a text
2. use adverbs of frequency and degree correctly in sentences
3. appreciate the importance of using adverbs correctly in communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 6.3.1 WORD CLASSES: ADVERBS
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs for Grade 8 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify adverbs of frequency and degree correctly from a text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use adverbs of frequency and degree correctly in sentences
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the importance of using adverbs correctly in communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should one use adverbs correctly?

SECTION: REMEMBER

2. use adverbs of frequency and degree correctly in sentences
3. appreciate the importance of using adverbs correctly in communication
